title: Clock as centerpiece
description: The clock becomes the dominant element: large and centered on its own row beneath a slim top bar carrying a small stop-name (top-left) and toggle (top-right). Inverts the header's visual hierarchy from route-first to clock-first.

changes.intent: Two-row layout: row 1 is a slim bar (stop-name left, toggle right); row 2 is the clock spanning full width, centered.
Route/stop confined to the slim top-left slot.
Toggle confined to the slim top-right slot.
Clock spans the full header width on row 2 and is horizontally centered.
Shrink stop-name so it reads as secondary chrome now that the clock dominates.
Enlarge the clock well beyond baseline to make it the visual centerpiece of the header.
